name: GDMenu
description: Bot (GDR2 / .gdbot, resume where you left off), always-on attempt clips (watch/save your last runs), frame stepper, searchable hacks tab, noclip (+limits, per player), speedhack (+music sync), pitch shift, physics bypass, all passable, jump hack, force platformer, free attempts, auto practice, practice music bypass, no particles/pulse/wave trail, unlock icons, hitboxes, start-pos switcher, quick respawn, hide pause, CBS/CBF bot compatibility, optional in-game HUD (FPS, CPS, best run, run-from, accurate noclip stats).

step-key.name: Frame Step Key
step-key.description: Advances one frame while the frame stepper is on. Hold to keep stepping. Click it in Settings to capture any key, modifier combo or mouse button.

resume-speed.name: Resume Speed
resume-speed.description: Game speed while fast-forwarding back to where you left off.

speedhack.name: Speedhack Value
speedhack.description: Game speed when Speedhack is on.

hud-scale.name: Button Size
hud-scale.description: Size of the floating GDM bubble and the stepper touch buttons.

stepper-touch-controls.name: Stepper Touch Buttons
stepper-touch-controls.description: +1 / +10 / Play buttons shown ONLY while the frame stepper is on. 'auto' = phones only.

hud-enabled.name: In-Game HUD
hud-enabled.description: Small overlay while you play: bot state, frame, percent and speed. Off by default so gameplay stays clean - GDMenu is otherwise invisible in game.

hud-anchor.name: HUD Corner
hud-anchor.description: Which screen corner the in-game HUD sits in.

hud-size.name: HUD Size
hud-size.description: Scale of the in-game HUD text.

hud-show-state.name: HUD: Bot State
hud-show-state.description: Show RECORDING / PLAYING / RESUMING (only while the bot is active).

hud-show-frame.name: HUD: Frame
hud-show-frame.description: Show the current physics tick (240 per second).

hud-show-speed.name: HUD: Speed
hud-show-speed.description: Show game speed while speedhack or resume fast-forward is active.

hud-show-inputs.name: HUD: Input Viewer
hud-show-inputs.description: Show which buttons you (or the bot) are holding right now: jump / left / right per player.

player-trail.name: Player Trail
player-trail.description: Draw the path your icon travels in your theme colour. Great for studying bot lines and wave corridors.

autosave-bot.name: Auto-Save Bot On Complete
autosave-bot.description: When you complete a level while recording, also save the replay automatically (level name + date).

custom-accent.name: Custom Theme Colour
custom-accent.description: The accent colour used when the theme is set to Custom (Style tab).

loop-playback.name: Loop Playback
loop-playback.description: While a bot is playing, automatically restart the attempt when it dies, so you can watch it run over and over.

stop-percent.name: Stop Playback At %
stop-percent.description: Playback stops automatically at this percent. 0 = disabled. Handy for practising a section.

practice-fix.name: Practice Fix
practice-fix.description: Restore exact player physics when respawning at a checkpoint while recording. Without this, bots recorded in practice mode can desync and die on playback.

input-fix.name: Physics Fix
input-fix.description: While recording, the player's position/speed is saved every tick; playback follows that exact path. Stops bots recorded in practice mode from dying.

clips-count.name: Attempt Clips Kept
clips-count.description: GDMenu always records your last N attempts (inputs only - no performance cost). Pause > GDMenu > Clips: watch any of them replay live like a video, or save it as .gdr2. 0 = off.

clips-pause-cbs.name: Pause CBS For Clips
clips-pause-cbs.description: Force vanilla Click Between Steps off while clips record, so clip replays are frame-perfect. Off by default: your CBS choice stays untouched while you play. Clips recorded with CBS/CBF on are flagged and may drift by less than a tick on replay.

manage-cbs.name: Pause CBS/CBF For Bot
manage-cbs.description: Click Between Steps (vanilla) and Click Between Frames (Syzzi's mod) land inputs between physics ticks, which tick-based replays can't reproduce. GDMenu pauses both while the bot records/plays and restores them afterwards (Eclipse does the same).

quick-respawn.name: Quick Respawn
quick-respawn.description: Automatically restart this many seconds after dying (Mega Hack style respawn time). 0 = off. Practice mode keeps vanilla checkpoint behaviour.

speedhack-audio.name: Sync Music With Speedhack
speedhack-audio.description: Pitch the song with the speedhack so music stays in sync while you play fast or slow (Eclipse / xdBot style). Restored automatically when the speedhack ends.

hitboxes-on-death.name: Force Hitboxes On Death
hitboxes-on-death.description: Keeps GD's 'show hitboxes on death' option forced on while this setting is on (Mega Hack style). Your vanilla option is untouched when this is off.

noclip-p2.name: Noclip: Player 2
noclip-p2.description: Noclip protects player 2 in dual / 2-player sections. Turn off to practice one side only (Mega Hack style).

noclip-hit-limit.name: Noclip Hit Limit
noclip-hit-limit.description: Once noclip has saved you this many times in one attempt, hits become lethal again (Mega Hack / Eclipse noclip limits). 0 = unlimited.

noclip-acc-limit.name: Noclip Accuracy Floor
noclip-acc-limit.description: When your noclip accuracy drops below this percent, hits become lethal again for the rest of the attempt. 0 = off.

cheat-indicator.name: Cheat Indicator
cheat-indicator.description: The floating GDM bubble shows CHEATS in red while any hack is active (Mega Hack style), so a recording/stream never hides it.

hud-show-fps.name: HUD: FPS
hud-show-fps.description: Real frames per second (measured on the wall clock, unaffected by speedhack).

hud-show-attempts.name: HUD: Attempts
hud-show-attempts.description: Attempt counter for the current level.

hud-show-time.name: HUD: Level Time
hud-show-time.description: Time since the attempt started (physics ticks / 240).

all-passable.name: All Passable (Experimental)
all-passable.description: Fall straight through blocks and solids - hazards still kill you (pair with noclip for full ghost mode). Counts as a cheat for Safe Mode. Experimental: platformer/spider behaviour may be odd.

jump-hack.name: Jump Hack (Infinite Jumps)
jump-hack.description: Hold jump in mid-air to keep re-jumping and hover upward (Mega Hack style). Counts as a cheat for Safe Mode.

physics-bypass.name: Physics Bypass (Experimental)
physics-bypass.description: Run physics at a fixed 240 ticks per second regardless of your monitor FPS (CBF / xdBot style bypass). Below ~15 render FPS the game slows down instead of skipping frames. Counts as a cheat for Safe Mode.

free-attempts.name: Free Attempts
free-attempts.description: The on-screen attempt counter stays at 1. Cosmetic only - the level's real saved attempt count is untouched.

force-platformer.name: Force Platformer (Experimental)
force-platformer.description: Play ANY level in platformer mode (hold-up gravity, platformer physics). The change is restored when you quit the level; restart the attempt after toggling. Counts as a cheat for Safe Mode.

auto-practice.name: Auto Practice Mode
auto-practice.description: Automatically enter practice mode when a level starts (same button path as the pause menu).

practice-music-bypass.name: Practice Music Bypass
practice-music-bypass.description: Checkpoint respawns in practice mode don't restart/resync the song - the music keeps flowing uninterrupted.

hide-pause.name: Hide Pause Menu
hide-pause.description: The pause menu closes itself after 0.8s (anti-rest). You can still click the GDM bubble in that window; if the GDMenu panel is open it will never auto-close. Off by default.

no-particles.name: No Particles
no-particles.description: Hide the particle objects levels spawn (fires, rain, ambient effects...). Applies to particles spawned after you turn it on; player death effects stay.

no-pulse.name: No Pulse
no-pulse.description: Pulse triggers leave colours untouched - no pulsing background/objects. Great for visibility while practising hard wave sections.

no-wave-trail.name: No Wave Trail
no-wave-trail.description: Hide the wave's trail streak in every gamemode.

unlock-icons.name: Unlock Icons
unlock-icons.description: Every icon appears unlocked in the garage. Client-side cosmetic only - server-side items (chests, shop, Gauntlet rewards) are untouched.

audio-pitch.name: Audio Pitch Shift
audio-pitch.description: Pitch the music up or down independently of game speed (1.00x = normal). Combines with Sync Music With Speedhack.

trail-length.name: Trail Length (Seconds)
trail-length.description: How many seconds of the Player Trail stay visible. The trail rolls smoothly - no flicker, no redraw cost.

hud-percent-decimals.name: HUD: Percent Decimals
hud-percent-decimals.description: Decimal places for the HUD percent readout (2.207-style precision).

hud-show-best.name: HUD: Best Run
hud-show-best.description: Show your best percent this session on the current level (resets when you switch levels).

hud-show-cps.name: HUD: CPS
hud-show-cps.description: Show jump clicks per second (measured on the wall clock, counts bot inputs while it plays).

hud-show-runfrom.name: HUD: Run From
hud-show-runfrom.description: Show the percent your current run started from (start position / practice checkpoint).
